_comment: Declares the expected pandas parse outcome for each tester CSV. Add an entry here whenever a new tester file is added. 'expect_parse_ok' = true means pd.read_csv() must succeed; false means it must raise an exception (the file intentionally contains a structural error that the app is designed to surface).

ASSAY.csv.reason: Comma-delimited; well-formed. Built for OSA = Human / Brain / single_cell_rna_seq (CDE v4.5) so that 'assay' and 'sample_source' show the exact single-value narrowing Step 2's downloaded template applies for this OSA. Produces CDE errors on 'sequencing_end' (invalid Enum value 'single-end') and 'RIN' (invalid Float value 'good'). 'instrument' demonstrates a valid semicolon-delimited multi-value entry ('10x_chromium_x;illumina_novaseq_6000' -- instrument is AllowMultiEnum) and is otherwise fully valid.

CLINPATH.csv.reason: Row 4 (subject_3) has exactly one extra spurious field ('ExtraField') beyond the 33-field header -- intentional example of a malformed input the app must reject.

PROTOCOL.csv.reason: Semicolon-delimited; well-formed; produces no CDE errors.

SAMPLE.csv.reason: Comma-delimited; well-formed; produces a single CDE error on 'condition_id' (invalid values 'IBD', 'IBD remission'). Refreshed against CDE v4.5: dropped 3 fields retired since v4.4 (condition, repeated_sample, visium_probe_set), added the newly-required 'preservation_method', and updated 'region_level_1' to current valid ontology tokens.

SUBJECT.csv.reason: Headers only (0 data rows); well-formed; nothing to validate.
